mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 74 degrees with overcast conditions near Harriet Park, and we have a waxing crescent moon in the sky.

The Verona Senior Center is currently seeking volunteers. They ask for a commitment of at least two times per month, and please note some roles involve light physical activity like climbing stairs or lifting. You can apply online or visit their front desk for a paper form.

There is plenty to do today, including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, the Epic Systems UGM is tomorrow and yoga sessions at Insight Wellness are also scheduled for tomorrow.
For our weekly report, on August 6, a local officer observed a vehicle driving erratically and subsequently arrested the driver for a fourth offence O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. The store is currently closed, but they will open at 10 AM, so head over then to get your fix.
